title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #11 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #11 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In which town did Mary live? (1 mark)
   A. Jericho
   B. Nain
   C. Nazareth
   D. Bethlehem

2. Which angel appeared to Mary? (1 mark)
   A. Michael
   B. Gabriel
   C. Raphael
   D. Peter

3. Which angel appeared to Zechariah? (1 mark)
   A. Uriel
   B. Gabriel
   C. Michael
   D. Raphael

4. What kind of life did Zechariah and Elizabeth lead? (1 mark)
   A. Wicked
   B. Righteous before God
   C. Lazy
   D. Selfish

5. Which is a kind way to help a blind person? (1 mark)
   A. Leave them out
   B. Greet them by name and offer to guide them
   C. Move their things
   D. Laugh at them

6. What did Bartimaeus call Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Son of David
   B. King of Egypt
   C. Priest
   D. Master of the house

7. Where were the ten men when they called to Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. In the temple
   B. At a distance
   C. In their homes
   D. Right beside Him

8. What did Jesus tell the ten men to do? (1 mark)
   A. Go home
   B. Wash in the river
   C. Go and show themselves to the priests
   D. Pay money

9. In which town did Jesus raise the widow's son? (1 mark)
   A. Jericho
   B. Cana
   C. Nain
   D. Nazareth

10. What did Joseph say about what his brothers intended? (1 mark)
   A. You are enemies
   B. You must pay
   C. You must leave
   D. You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good

11. Which statement about forgiveness is true? (1 mark)
   A. Forgiving means telling lies
   B. Forgiving means the wrong was fine
   C. Forgiving is a sign of weakness
   D. Forgiving takes courage

12. According to Acts 20:35, what is more blessed? (1 mark)
   A. To give than to receive
   B. To keep than to give
   C. To buy than to sell
   D. To sleep than to work

13. Which is an example of helping a classmate? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding your pencil
   B. Laughing at him
   C. Sharing your pencil
   D. Telling lies

14. What causes joy among the angels of God, according to Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. A new building
   B. One sinner who repents
   C. A large crowd
   D. A rich person giving

15. Where is the parable of the mustard seed found in Luke? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 1:37
   B. Luke 15:8
   C. Luke 19:5
   D. Luke 13:18-19

16. What does the big tree stand for? (1 mark)
   A. The growth of God's kingdom
   B. A palace
   C. A mountain
   D. A market

17. What question did Nicodemus ask about being born again? (1 mark)
   A. Who is God?
   B. Where is Jerusalem?
   C. How can someone be born when old?
   D. Who are you?

18. What group did Nicodemus belong to? (1 mark)
   A. The shepherds
   B. The Romans
   C. The disciples
   D. The Pharisees

19. Which helpline can children in Kenya call for help? (1 mark)
   A. 555
   B. 900
   C. 10
   D. 116

20. Which of these is a sign of an unsafe secret? (1 mark)
   A. It is about a game
   B. It makes you feel scared or uncomfortable
   C. It is about a surprise gift
   D. It makes you happy

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Name two people you can trust at home or school. (2 marks)

22. Explain why trusting God is important and how a child shows that they trust Him. (5 marks)

23. Explain how children can help the needy at school, at home and in church. (5 marks)

24. Describe the naming of John. (4 marks)

25. Explain how a child can show faith in God when they or a family member is sick. (5 marks)

26. Explain what it means to be assertive and give an example. (4 marks)

27. Describe how Jesus responded when Bartimaeus called for mercy. (3 marks)

28. State two things the angel said about John before he was born. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #11 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Nazareth
   Luke 1:26 says Gabriel came to Nazareth in Galilee.

2. B — Gabriel
   Luke 1:26 says God sent the angel Gabriel.

3. B — Gabriel
   Gabriel said, "I stand in the presence of God."

4. B — Righteous before God
   Luke 1:6 says both were righteous.

5. B — Greet them by name and offer to guide them
   Kindness and respect help people with disabilities.

6. A — Son of David
   He called out, "Jesus, Son of David."

7. B — At a distance
   They stood at a distance and called out.

8. C — Go and show themselves to the priests
   Luke 17:14 records this instruction.

9. C — Nain
   Luke 7:11 says Nain.

10. D — You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good
   Genesis 50:20 records this.

11. D — Forgiving takes courage
   Forgiveness is strong, not weak.

12. A — To give than to receive
   Acts 20:35 quotes Jesus' words.

13. C — Sharing your pencil
   Sharing meets a need.

14. B — One sinner who repents
   Luke 15:10 says this.

15. D — Luke 13:18-19
   Luke 13:18-19 contains the parable.

16. A — The growth of God's kingdom
   The kingdom grows large.

17. C — How can someone be born when old?
   He was puzzled about a second birth.

18. D — The Pharisees
   He was a Pharisee.

19. D — 116
   Childline Kenya's number is 116.

20. B — It makes you feel scared or uncomfortable
   Bad secrets should be told to trusted adults.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Parent, guardian, teacher, counsellor, grandparent.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (5 marks)
   Answer: God made us, loves us and is faithful. He hears prayers and has helped people in the Bible. A child shows trust by praying every day, reading the Bible, obeying His teaching, and thanking Him for help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's love, 1 for faithfulness, 1 for prayer, 1 for Bible or obedience, 1 for thanks.

23. (5 marks)
   Answer: School: share a pencil or lunch, help a struggling classmate. Home: help with chores, give clothes that still fit. Church: take part in collections, visit the sick with parents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of school, home and church, and 2 marks for clear explanations.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: On the eighth day people wanted to call him Zechariah. Elizabeth said his name is John. They asked Zechariah, who wrote, "His name is John." His speech returned and he praised God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

25. (5 marks)
   Answer: Pray, believe that God cares, ask trusted adults, go to a clinic or hospital for treatment, thank God for help, and continue to trust. Faith does not mean ignoring doctors.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for prayer, 1 for belief in God's care, 1 for seeking treatment, 1 for thanks, 1 for continuing to trust.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: Being assertive means standing for what is right calmly and firmly. Example: refusing to copy in a test and politely saying, "No, that is cheating."
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 for calm and firm, 1 for example, 1 for clear explanation.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus stopped and said, "Call him." He asked what he wanted, then healed him and told him that his faith had healed him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for stopping, 1 for asking, 1 for healing.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: He would bring joy, be great before the Lord, be filled with the Holy Spirit, and turn many to God. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.
